title: FM27 Release Date — 10 November 2026 on PC, Console, Mobile & Touch
description: Football Manager 27 releases on 10 November 2026 across PC, Mac, Xbox, PS5, mobile and Apple Arcade — and the free Launch Preview runs 29 October to 3 November.
meta: Updated 30 October 2026. The PC/Mac Launch Preview is now available; digital release is 10 November 2026.
body:
Football Manager 27 releases on 10 November 2026. The PC/Mac Launch Preview is now available: the free Launch Preview runs from 18:00 GMT on 29 October for five days, and saves you start there carry into the full game.

The date, platform by platform

  • 10 November 2026 — FM27 on PC and Mac via Steam, Epic and the Xbox PC app, including Xbox Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass.
  • Digital release, same date — FM27 Console on Xbox and PS5, FM27 Mobile via Netflix, and FM27 Touch on Apple Arcade for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV.

Physical editions: the official product FAQ lists PC retail for 10 November and PS5 retail for 20 November 2026. The 10 November date above refers to digital releases.

Price and pre-purchase

The retail price is £49.99, and pre-purchase opens alongside the free Preview on 29 October with 10% off via SEGA-approved digital retailers. After 18:00 GMT on 3 November, pre-purchasers can continue the paid Preview until launch; eligible Game Pass subscribers can continue through their subscription.

The Launch Preview: 29 October to 3 November

For the official store links and download steps, use our FM27 free-play guide.

The Launch Preview is free to play from 29 October 18:00 GMT until 3 November 18:00 GMT on PC/Mac across Steam, Epic, the Microsoft Store, Xbox Game Pass and PC Game Pass. Every game mode is available, there is no sign-up, and it replaces what used to be called Beta or Advanced Access. Saves started during the window continue into launch.

You can use the Preview to start a save and explore the available player data. Preview assets and some data may change before release.

What to read while you wait

  • FM27 wonderkids — the method behind a credible young-player shortlist.
  • FM27 cheap players & bargains — the filters that find value signings.
  • FM27 tactics — what changed in the tactical system.
  • FM27 guides index — all of our Football Manager 27 coverage.

Does Preview progress carry over?

Yes. The official announcement says saves continue from the free Preview into the paid Preview and full launch. It also warns that some player data and club or player assets are still awaiting rights-holder approval, so Preview content may change.
